profile.name: 运动目标节点
profile.description: 这是一个用于机器人运动状态图中的目标逻辑组件，而非独立物理仪器。它用于在实验自动化或机器人控制流程中组织任务、约束与监视条件，支持目标编排、顺序执行以及关节状态符号引用，常见于机械臂等运动规划场景。
profile.description_en: This is a software goal component used in a robot motion statechart rather than a standalone physical instrument. It is used in laboratory automation or robotic control workflows to organize tasks, constraints, and monitor conditions, supporting goal composition, sequential arrangement, and joint-state symbol references, typically in manipulator motion-planning scenarios.
